reads.need: Care work is the largest skilled family
reads.evidence: 48 nursing and care postings, ahead of 43 for engineers. Office and admin leads overall at 80.
reads.quality: These are jobs residents can train into close to home, and the town needs them filled.
reads.move: Map the nursing and medical-assistant training within a bus ride, and which employers hire from each program.
reads.why: Title matching is blunt, and the feed undercounts small employers.

reads.need: The longest trip to work of the ten towns
reads.evidence: A mean commute of 30.5 minutes, the highest here, with the lowest median household income at $72,750.
reads.quality: The residents with the least to spend are spending the most time getting to work.
reads.move: Look at which job centers Inglewood residents travel to and whether the new rail stops shorten those trips.
reads.why: Survey averages. They say how long, not where to.

gaps: Hiring at the stadium and arena, much of which is event-day work and may not be posted here.
